title: Design Thinking Lesson
description: Guide students through empathize, define, ideate, prototype, and test steps to solve a real problem.

steps.title: Empathize
steps.guidance: Students research user needs via interviews, surveys, or observations.

steps.title: Define
steps.guidance: Teams synthesize findings and write a clear problem statement.

steps.title: Ideate
steps.guidance: Brainstorm multiple solutions; encourage divergent thinking and sketching.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.guidance: Build low-fidelity prototypes using available materials or digital tools.

steps.title: Test
steps.guidance: Gather feedback, reflect, and iterate on prototypes.
